correctness.rationale: For every nonzero frequency, irreducibility of Φ_p forces all rational overlap coefficients equal; a proper support has at least one zero coefficient, while nonnegative overlap forces all zero precisely at missing support differences. At full positive support, constancy of products g_x g_{x-a} and odd prime cyclicity force g constant. Prior Weyl orthogonality gives singular values √p|A| and exact Weyl kernel. Explicit e0+e_a versus e0+i e_a phase ambiguities or the constant-window Fourier ambiguity give necessity. Cauchy–Davenport and direct F11 differences prove the sharp auxiliary facts; NumPy full lifting independently checked 348 finite windows. Exact proof unrestricted, computation corroborative only.

value.rationale: The precise rank, all kernel directions and full-signal recovery threshold of a natural p²-measurement tomography system become support invariants under arbitrary rational-positive reweighting. A non-difference-set p=11 support yields a robustly structural family of valid windows rather than a single example. The sharp lower-rank threshold, exact failure modes and rational/real boundary make it a motivated classification beyond a numerical computation or routine normalization; no unproved stability advantage is advertised.
